purpose: The target graph model. Records from ontology_extraction.json are mapped onto this mechanically by src/graph/loader.py; change this mapping, not the extraction schema, as the model evolves.

Document.note: One per constituent part of the pack. 48 of them, derived from the running headers.

Clause.note: The retrieval unit. chunk_type is clause | definition | preamble | table. page_start/page_end replace a single page: clauses span page breaks.

Definition.note: term alone is NOT unique - 16 terms are defined both globally (Joint Schedule 1) and locally in a schedule that overrides it within its own document.

Provision.note: provision_type in (definition, procedure, statement) - kept so every record is materialised and nothing is silently dropped.

Defined_Event.note: A trigger, verbatim from the clause.

relationships.PART_OF: (:Clause)-[:PART_OF]->(:Clause|:Document)  - the numbering hierarchy, for small-to-big retrieval
relationships.CROSS_REFERENCES: (:Clause)-[:CROSS_REFERENCES {reference_text, ref_class, scope_rule, resolution, page}]->(:Clause)  - stored once, directed; queried both ways. Cycles exist: traversal must be acyclic and depth-capped.
relationships.STATED_IN: (semantic node)-[:STATED_IN]->(:Clause)  - every semantic node has one; zero orphans is a load-time assertion
relationships.EXCLUDED_FROM_CAP: (:Liability_Cap)-[:EXCLUDED_FROM_CAP]->(:Clause)  - where the clause expressly excludes a cap

normalisation.note: Money and durations are normalised in src/graph/normalise.py at load time, never by the LLM. The LLM copies verbatim so the value can be checked character-for-character against the source.
normalisation.duration: '30 days' -> P30D; '3 Working Days' -> P3D with working_days: true, kept distinct from calendar days

indexes.note: hierarchy_path is embedded with the text because standard provisions recur near-verbatim across schedules; the path carries the schedule name that separates them.

deferred_to_v3: Lot scoping - prices and specification vary by Lot 1-4; the agent must not state Lot-specific prices as general facts.
Service_Level / Service Credit modelling for Call-Off Schedule 14.
VARIES overrides for the jurisdiction variants (MOD Terms, Scottish Law, Northern Ireland Law) - currently only tagged on Document.
Order of precedence between Core Terms, Schedules and the Order Form as a graph relationship rather than prose.
Table content extraction - tables are stored as markdown chunks, not as queryable data.
